title: BODY HINGE PILLAR & DOOR SILL EXTENSION & FILLER
summary: Front door hinge pillars (A-pillar lower, LH/RH), the windshield lower bonding strip, the door sill extension and the filler panel at the front of the door opening, plus the weatherstrip between the windshield frame and the bonding strip. The panels are bonded (bonds B, D, E, K) with 51r/87b/226b adhesive; the windshield bonding strip is riveted to the lower windshield frame corner through three drilled holes, and rivets also go into the upper hinge pillar.
